[[File:Pike_sisters.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The Pike Sisters]]
{{Quote|The Pike sisters. Genetic twins, not clones. The one on the right is Zan, the other is Zu. Zan has green eyes, Zu has one green and one blue eye, the only noticeable difference. They are masters of ''teräs käsi'', the Bunduki art called 'steel hands.' Twenty-six standard years old, no political affiliations, no criminal records in any of the major systems, and, as far as we are able to determine, completely amoral.|[[Guri]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
The '''Pike Sisters''' were a pair of twin [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Epicanthix]] composed of [[Zan Pike]] and [[Zu Pike]]. 

In their youth, their [[Dux Pike's wife|mother]] sent them to [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]] in order to be educated by the revered [[Followers of Palawa]] hermits. The twins studied history, literature and philosophy of the Sector, as well as physical discipline and [[Unarmed combat|martial arts]], such as [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teras Kasi]], instructed to use it for the benefit of society. The sisters quickly rose through the ranks of their fellow students and then decided to use their mastery for personal profit.<ref name="sotesb" />

They started their career as fighters in the [[Pacanth Reach/Legends|Pacanth Reach]] and from there their career expanded within the illegal combat scene, traveling between hidden arenas and secretly in pleasure halls to entertain high-class beings. Cunning, ambitious and distrustful, they cooperated with nobody and acted as their own booking agents.<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

After the death of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], they changed their names, referring to themselves as the Pikkel Sisters.<ref name="Evolution">''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire: Evolution]]''</ref>

They were noted for their beauty, ruthlessness. They wore [[Palawa tunic]]s, and never used weapons; except blades attached to the tips of their braids, which caused harm as they moved them. Despite their cold lack of emotion, they both carried along with them satchels with personal mementos.<ref name="sotesb" />
